Assistant ProfessorB.Sc (Computer Science, Bishop Cotton Women’s Christian College, Bangalore), M.Sc (Computer Science, St. Joseph’s Post Graduation College), B.Ed (KIET B.Ed College, Bangalore) Linkedin Link Ms. Vasugi Mudaliar R.K. is an Assistant Professor with 15 years of teaching experience. She serves as the II Year BCA Coordinator and Timetable Coordinator. She strongly believes in continuous learning and evolving pedagogical approaches through adapting to emerging technologies. As an Innovation Ambassador, she actively mentors students, organises hackathons and coordinates major technical events, including Smart India Hackathons and college tech fests.
